onboarding.welcomeTitle: Your fan spending and plans, in one app.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Enjoy supporting your favorites within the budget you set.
onboarding.featureBudgetBody: Leftovers and overspending both carry over to next month.

onboarding.gmailBody: Connect Gmail to read ticket payment confirmation emails and record tickets and shows automatically.
